svg.text: paracidovorax: S6 v0.1 site groups (target scope, assembly only)

Neighbour genes in core orientation, coloured by homology group (same colour = homologous); red dashed = mobile-keyword gene skipped for the host window. Site groups are repeated observations of one position, not independent insertion events.
Same position needs >= 2 ordered, orientation-consistent unique host matches on each side; groups are cliques of such pairs with one occurrence per assembly. Hover a gene for its product.
